name: nx_pipe
prototype: int nx_pipe(int *fds, size_t bufsize, int flags)

ownership.argument: Anchors the loop pipe identity; register_inode is called with the operations table as its second argument.

provenance.source: Formats '/var/pipe/%d' from the FIFO counter dword_200EE948, allocates the 1024-byte FIFO (the twin 0xC1A5F88 takes the size as an argument), then calls register_inode 0xC1AFFD8 with pipe_file_operations 0x2CCBE5A4 and file type 438 before opening both ends through 0xC1D0A98.

notes: Anchors the loop pipe identity; register_inode is called with the operations table as its second argument. Callable address is the Thumb entry; the symbol exists to anchor the pipe identity, not as a module call site.
